auth.d: Spoken as written in STATE.md's header. The countersign follows, first line, exact, then the board. The ritual is never explained and never printed here.

changes.t: SOP stood up. **BOLO** ruled for the watchlist (bench FRAGO · WARNO · Fire Watch retired). **Boresight** ruled (back-brief struck; INTEL to the pool). **Break-break / buttonhook back** ruled. **Ivory tower** coded. House format coded (§7). Trunk discipline (BLACK · ORANGE · OPERATOR). Lexicon doctrine (§6): the Corps is the bootstrap. "Set me up" retired; **sit rep** is the trigger. **ENDEX** provisional. PMCS created. Ready Rack / Magazine provisional.
The SOI card added as Block VII of every board, by order.
**Run the darkroom** coded; garbles black room / dark room read the same.
The dictation codebook (§8) coded. House names spoken: BLACK = Bold Venture · ORANGE = Ultrasin.
**Belay that** provisional. One value, one block (§7 rule 8).
**The OUT block** coded (§7 rule 9). RECON · NAPKIN · SYLLABUS · DISTILL · GRAMMAR benched. The proword selection loop proposed (BOLO 37), name bench MINT (rec).

The front page (BOLO 38): the sit rep becomes a dashboard. The colorway ruled (the creator-cases palette for every internal board). **FRAGO** ruled as the BOLO status page. **TTP** ruled for the lessons block (over GOUGE). **RTB** replaces sweep. **Charlie Mike** ruled for resuming a card. **SOI** ruled as the name of the tongue's book — this page, its own dashboard. Garble rows: me this it rep · Rebel Writer · desk training · CK three · Frango.

**SOI published as its own page** (Charlie Mike on the pages). **OPORD N** = the standing BOLO page (provisional word) · **FRAGO N** = the update onto it (ruled), clarified 9/10 late. **"Glossary" retired as a word** — the button, the key, and the page all say SOI. Garble rows: shit rep · Charlie and Mike · below forty-five.

**DOPE SHEET ruled** as the BOLO status page's name (header DOPE SHEET N · spoken "the dope on N"); OPORD retired. **"The house tongue" retired** — not SOP; "the lexicon" (SOP §6's own word) stands, provisional. **Theme ruled: DARK only**, the toggle removed; the light face becomes **E-INK** (Kindle gray), provisional. **Implied retired** from DARKROOM's dress axis; its opposite benched (ADORNED rec). Cancel-word bench opened (AS YOU WERE rec). "Caught up" reserved in the pool. BOLOs 47 · 48 · 49 opened.

**ABORT** ruled as the cancel word (spoken three times; belay retired). **BREVITY** ruled as what the SOI holds, the subtitle on every page. **HOTLINE** ruled as the operator's callsign — casual Hotline, formal **HOTLINE ACTUAL** on the net; "you" retired from the rail. The close-out word (ENDEX collides with "index") benched: LIBERTY CALL rec.

**Oscar Mike is the close-out, all in one** — cache note · STATE · journal · the OUT block. The park-a-card mechanic retired for new work (the DOPE SHEETs carry the resume orders). **ENDEX retired.** RTB keeps one meaning: send an old parked card home. The close-out bench closed.

**Gear N** provisional: the agent ceiling (1 = 3 default · 2 = 6 · 3 = 9 · 4 = 12 · 5 = 15 never); **the gearbox** named as the sustainable-speed system (BOLO 52). Warps and DEFCON aborted in the same breath. **Proword** defined on the page (procedure word, ACP 125). Section numbers dropped from the headers by Papi's order. BOLOs 51 · 52 · 53 opened.
